story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.angus_stage1_gr: The facility managed to react to your arrival. The pirates have taken up pre-prepared defensive positions. Access to the fourth and fifth floors is blocked, but the admiral is still up there. You can force your way through by bypassing the security protocols. Reach the third floor—the control computer located there can be used to reprogram the elevator.
story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.angus_stage2_tr: You have no business being here. This is a pirate vault, not the objective of the operation. Do not waste time and resources—return to the elevator and continue the mission.
story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.angus_stage3_co: Excellent. One of the most important commanders of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> has been eliminated. Operational skill bordering on genius. I will continue guiding you. Take the <color=#FFFEC1>Comm Key</color> off the corpse and insert it into the control computer by the elevator. That will open the way.
story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.angus_stage4_co: Enough. We are receiving analysis... The neurolinguistic report indicates that the target has lost the will to fight and is attempting to replace real defense with rhetoric. Resistance is broken. Proceed to the fifth floor and eliminate the admiral.
story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.angus_stage4_gr: Proceed carefully. Failure at this stage is unacceptable. 50% of the operation is complete. The terminal keeping the fifth floor locked is on this level. It is a small information computer. Destroy it, and the path to the admiral will be open.
story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.angus_stage5_fa: Loss of the valuable asset confirmed. Hargeysa has been destroyed. The outcome of the operation is unacceptable.
story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.angus_stage5_se: The admiral is dead, but our analytical satellite, connected to the station's systems, is detecting a critical change in the reactor's control loop. An artificial emergency scenario has been launched. An interesting move by the pirates—the trigger was linked to the admiral's heartbeat. Hargeysa is about to be destroyed in a nuclear explosion. New objective. You must not allow the loss of this asset. Find the control computer and destroy it—there is no time to reprogram it. There is very little time left before the reactor is destroyed, hurry.
story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.angus_stage5_wi: The threat of reactor detonation has been eliminated. Operation completed successfully. Evacuation authorized.
story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.commpirate_stag: Lost your way, clone? Without the <color=#FFFEC1>Comm Key</color>, there's no way you'll get into the control computer. And the key is with me. Come over here and take it off my corpse, if you can. Dead men don't bite.
story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.evilpirate_stag: You managed to crawl here after all, clone. The terminal is right here, next to me. I want to see how far you'll go before you drop dead.
story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.jane_stage3_han: Looks like they managed to wire an automatic lock into the loop. Magnum's sensors are detecting a new lockdown on the fifth floor. The control terminal is on the fourth level. One second... Yes, it's a small computer in one of the break rooms. Find it and open the path forward.
story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.sseth_stage2_tr: Hey, hey, salvage nation! Looks like we've got a parasite in the treasury. I'm authorizing part of the crew to leave their battle stations and go on a hunt. Who gets pulled off defense is to be decided strictly by drawing lots. I will personally pay a reward to whoever kills the clone.
story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.sseth_stage4_co: All right, clone. Crawl your way up. I'm waiting. Just don't imagine you're climbing to yet another deck guarded by my overly humane friends. You're forcing your way into the place where the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> lives not by contracts, not by orders, and not by your fake little <color=#FFFEC1>dignitas</color> numbers on ship transponders. We live by rust, old seafaring spite, and iron that cuts your hands to the bone. That's why we die standing. Come on up. Just don't lose your shit.
story.rwa_2_treasure.dlg.sseth_stage5_gr: This is where all this running around the floors ends. Welcome to my atomic deck. Now let's see if clones absorb lead as fast as food.
story.rwa_2_treasure.name: Treasure Island
story.rwa_2_treasure.objective0: Eliminate the admiral of the Unchained Belt on the station's fifth floor.
story.rwa_2_treasure.objective1: The Unchained Belt is destroyed. Evacuation authorized.
story.rwa_2_treasure.stage1.name: Service Level
story.rwa_2_treasure.stage2.name: Treasury
story.rwa_2_treasure.stage3.name: Control Level
story.rwa_2_treasure.stage4.name: Hangar

story.rwa_3_light.after:
Boss, you should see this. The Hexarchs and the rest of the corporations are already farting out notes of protest across all channels. RealWare has subjected the surface of Venus to a massive nuclear-phase bombardment. Quasimorph activity is no longer being detected. Tezctlan has been destroyed—or, at any rate, securely cut off from the physical world. Most likely, the Feathered Masks perished with him.

RealWare requests that we await the next assignment. Something important is starting on Mars. Before retreating into another fit of madness, Eipschwitz managed to upload the technical documentation for the assembly of a Phase Bomb into the systems of the Magnum.
story.rwa_3_light.briefing: One minute to the designated landing point near the <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Temple</color>. Quasimorph sensors are blinded by powerful radiation, so we no longer have a reliable picture. Naturally, the quasimorphs are ready to meet you. <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> feels all of <color=#FFFEC1>Venus</color> and is definitely aware of our arrival, so resistance will be fierce. The orbital satellite with the nuclear payload is also moving to the drop point. I hope you two meet soon. Receive the device, wait for the signal that it has dropped into the correct position, and await further instructions.
story.rwa_3_light.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Ensure the safe landing of the atomic bomb at the <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Temple</color>.
story.rwa_3_light.details:
Details: RealWare continues to restore order across the Solar System. The time has come to strike at the main source of disruption—Tezctlan. According to data from the RealWare combat AI, it is through the Feathered Temple on Venus that the Emerald Empire keeps most of the quasimorphs in the physical world, and Tezctlan himself is likely deep within the temple complex. Important! In violation of NCE norms, RealWare has authorized a nuclear strike on the temple's territory. However, conventional orbital bombardment would be ineffective. Structures phased in from Gannix are too resilient, and serious damage can only be dealt to the parts of the Temple located on the surface. Therefore, the payload will be delivered directly to the target. Our task is to receive it and ensure it is placed at a specific calculated point. A detonation there should trigger a chain of tectonic failures throughout the entire temple complex area.

Additional: The nuclear payload will be delivered from orbit in a locked state. The full arming key remains with RealWare command until delivery is confirmed. Once the payload is placed and confirmed by our operator, activation will be performed from orbit.
story.rwa_3_light.dlg.ancom_stage1_phase: <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color>, we are not interested in the nuclear payload. However, allowing <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> to acquire an effective anti-quasimorph weapon is unacceptable. They already have enough power to dictate terms to half the Solar System. Give them a way to reliably burn out bramfaturas, and very soon they will start deciding which worlds are worth saving and which are more useful when kept in fear. We cannot allow that.
story.rwa_3_light.dlg.angus_stage1_bomb: Excellent. The payload is at the calculated point. Running a geoscan... One hundred percent confirmation. <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color>, say goodbye to the clone. I am activating the charge.
story.rwa_3_light.dlg.angus_stage1_bomb_: Activation complete. The operative has a brief window for evacuation. The mission is already considered a success. Whether the clone survives or burns with the Temple will not affect the outcome.
story.rwa_3_light.dlg.angus_stage1_phase: Spare me your moral arithmetic. <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color>, fight your way to the device and complete the installation of the phase detonator. Be advised: if necessary, I will activate the bomb without it.
story.rwa_3_light.dlg.angus_stage2_eleva: Confirmed. It is <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color>. I imagine you will find it interesting to know that a few years ago, those bastards already stole one of <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color>'s nuclear payloads. Looks like they decided to try again. The objective remains unchanged. Fight your way to the bomb and install your detonator.
story.rwa_3_light.dlg.eipschwitz_stage1_: Do not rush to bury the king of the quasimorph realm, idiot. An ordinary blast—even a nuclear one—will solve nothing here. You will vitrify the surface for a while, and then those delightful creatures will come spilling back out of Gannix through telephaturic rifts. If you actually want to destroy a quasimorph instead of setting off fireworks, you need a phase detonator. And I can build one right here, out of local junk.

Now listen carefully. You cannot build a phase detonator out of sticks and stones. I need a proper workbench. The taltnoms who remain permanently in physical reality must have one somewhere. A workshop, a ritual forge, an altar bench—call it whatever you like, I do not care. Just find it. I assume there is no point looking outside. Carry me straight into the Temple.
story.rwa_3_light.dlg.eipschwitz_stage2_:
All right, good. We made it. Now listen carefully and try not to confuse anything. You need to carry me to a workstation. I do not care what kind, as long as it has tools and usable metal. There is already more than enough of everything else down here.

And while we are at it, explain something to me. How did you people end up working for RealWare? Those idiots have been twisting and mangling the Solar System for so long it is a wonder it is still holding together. And now they think one especially powerful explosion will set everything right? Even if we do everything properly today, it will not cure quasimorphosis. At best, it will postpone the next breach. At worst, RealWare will simply push the world into a state where quasimorphs no longer have to force their way in. They will just leave the door open.

Wait, wait, wait. Here it is. This is enough. Use the workbench—you will be my hands. I will show <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> that <color=#FFFEC1>Dennett</color> wasted their dignitas on yet another quasibio-cryptogeoanalyzer. Everything I need is lying right here under our feet.

That is enough genius from me for one day. In front of you is a Phase Bomb. For our purposes, it will serve perfectly well as a detonator. Carry it back to the device and attach it. Now the nuclear blast will melt more than stone—it will strike at <color=#FFFEC1>Gannix</color> itself. You have no idea how badly I want to see what happens.
story.rwa_3_light.dlg.jane_stage1_lift: Be careful. Below lies a zone of severe phasic distortion. The outer surface of the Temple is still more or less anchored to <color=#FFFEC1>Venus</color>, but it is impossible to say for sure whether the temple itself is submerged in Gannix or already completely inside Venus. Expect fierce resistance.
story.rwa_3_light.dlg.jane_stage2_elevat: Bad news, boss. An unidentified heavy interplanetary spacecraft has appeared in orbit. It's performing maneuvers typical of troop deployment. There's a high probability the enemy intends to intercept the object before the payload is activated.
story.rwa_3_light.dlg.space_intro:
RealWare has completed the redistribution of assets across the internal operational sectors of the AnCap system.

Pockets of destabilization that had prevented us from launching full-scale order-enforcement measures have been suppressed. Independent armed groups in the Main Belt have suffered unacceptable losses. Logistical risks have been reduced to tolerable levels. We can now address not the symptoms, but the cause.

According to the assessment of our combat AI, the primary source of the current disturbance is located on Venus. Tezctlan's activity can no longer be treated as a local anomaly. What we are dealing with is a hostile power center turning the region into a full-scale staging ground for further expansion.

There is new work for you. A strike will be carried out against the Feathered Temple on the surface of Venus. RealWare will handle the main body of the operation. You will be required to provide limited support through one of your operators.
story.rwa_3_light.dlg.space_outro:
You performed satisfactorily. The effectiveness of the phase bomb has been confirmed.

Do not expect us to keep clearing every obstacle for you in person. We currently have urgent business on Mars that requires a direct military response.

We are aware that the manufacturing instructions for the phase bomb are now stored in the systems of HIS Magnum. That is sufficient for your purposes, but insufficient for the next phase of the operation. We have transferred a container carrying a tactical nuclear device to your custody. Await further instructions.

And do not flatter yourself, mercenary. The nuclear device is locked. The full arming sequence and the authority to activate it remain exclusively with RealWare. You will deliver it where ordered. We will take care of the rest.
story.rwa_3_light.dlg.yan_stage1_bomb:
What is going on down there, Magnum? Give me the feed from the hold... Ah. I see. Doctor Eipschwitz, I presume?

Angus, we will have to delay activation. If that head claims the payload can be made effective, we will proceed on the assumption that it can. Doctor Dennett warned me that Eipschwitz may be insane, but he is wrong less often than any of our instruments. Magnum, you have a new assignment. Send the doctor to the surface immediately. Let him modify the payload. I need a positive result, not just the explosion itself.
story.rwa_3_light.name: Let there be light!
story.rwa_3_light.objective0: Ensure the detonation of the RealWare atomic bomb.
story.rwa_3_light.objective1: Nuclear bomb activated. Time until detonation: {0} turns. Evacuation authorized.
story.rwa_3_light.stage1.name: Temple Outskirts
story.rwa_3_light.stage2.name: Taltnom Army
story.rwa_4a_whirl.after: <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> has been destroyed. <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> is assuming control of the assets seized by <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color>. Remaining pockets of resistance are being suppressed as a matter of routine. Command reports that the corporation's next strategic objective is to establish observational control over <color=#FFFEC1>Earth's</color> orbit. The time has come to declare, once and for all, that the achievements of the <color=#FFFEC1>Great Anarchist Revolution</color> have been saved—and to personally ensure that there will be no further failures in the AnCap system.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.briefing: <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> is entrenched deeply enough in physical reality to exert control over the atmosphere of <color=#FFFEC1>Mars</color>. Everything that approaches the fortress too closely is burned out of the sky. So we will not be able to drop you right at the entrance. We will drop you where we can, and you will walk from there. The moment your boots touch the ground, you are considered a written-off asset. But not every clone gets the honor of throwing a phasonuclear charge into the face of a creature that so enjoys calling itself a god. Good luck, and goodbye.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Throw the phasonuclear charge at <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> from close range.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.details:
Details: RealWare does not forgive traitors. A significant part of Shedu's Thousand consists of former corporate soldiers who abandoned discipline and chose the path of technobarbarians in the service of the quasimorph Urparp. Now it is time to collect on that debt. Using Eipschwitz's research, RealWare has created a new munition—a tactical phasonuclear charge, capable of damaging not only physical structures but quasimorphic entities as well. The device has already been delivered to the Magnum. You will need to take it with you on the mission. According to calculations from the RealWare combat AI, the only way to destroy Urparp for good is to bring the charge to a minimal distance from the target. In other words, you will have to literally throw the bomb at Urparp. Important! Extraction of the operative is impossible by design. Detonation will occur immediately once the charge reaches the target. The operation is strictly a one-way trip. The operative is considered an expended asset from the moment it begins.

Additional Info: Shedu's Thousand has turned the Sinkhole Oasis into a fortified zone. Before reaching Urparp, the clone will have to fight his way to this fortress alone.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.dlg.jane_stage1_five_: You heard that? Don't hang around there. The mission is considered complete only once <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> is destroyed. What we need is a finished contract, not a pointless slaughter one step away from completion.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.dlg.jane_stage1_on_li: That's it. The elevator goes down to <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color>. Once you get there, you'll have no other tasks left.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.dlg.jane_stage4_urpar: Urparp has been destroyed. RealWare confirms successful contract completion. Extraction authorized. Since you're somehow still alive, there will be more work for you soon.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.dlg.realware_stage1_f: Analysis complete. A direct channel into <color=#FFFEC1>Ur</color> has been opened on the surface. Every enemy you kill is immediately pulled by <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> out of the bramfatura and thrown back onto the battlefield. New mission parameter: clearing the drop zone is impossible.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.dlg.realware_stage1_t: Something is wrong. We are detecting an anomaly in the quasimorphic data coming from the reconnaissance satellite. Initiating deep analysis. Continue the mission.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.dlg.realware_stage4_f: First lockout circuit deactivated. Nuclear weapons are now available for manual release from the craft. Nuclear strike readiness: twenty-five percent.

NCE lockout deactivated. Readiness one hundred percent. I am authorizing the strike on the Sinkhole Oasis. Time to execution: immediate.

The Sinkhole Oasis has been destroyed. We are registering a weakening of Urparp's phase-link to reality. Find him and kill him.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.dlg.realware_stage4_g: Good. You are still alive. <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> vanished from <color=#FFFEC1>Mars</color> and appeared aboard the <color=#FFFEC1>Ares</color>. The spacecraft's structural frame will begin to fail very soon, and all attempts to kill the quasimorph by conventional means have proven ineffective. Just before it burned up, the reconnaissance satellite transmitted a new batch of quasimorphic data. Analysis complete. There are four special signatures in the <color=#FFFEC1>Sinkhole Oasis</color>. Destroy them, and Urparp's link to reality will weaken enough for him to be killed. There is no time for a ground operation. The Oasis will be destroyed by a nuclear strike. But under <color=#FFFEC1>NCE</color> requirements, the launch is locked. There are four authorization terminals on this level. Activate all of them. Once that is done, we will incinerate the <color=#FFFEC1>Sinkhole Oasis</color>.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.dlg.realware_stage4_t: Deactivation of the third lockout circuit confirmed. <color=#FFFEC1>NCE</color> restrictions have been lifted for emergency release of nuclear charges. Nuclear strike readiness from HIS Ares: seventy-five percent.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.dlg.realware_wrong_bo: Please refrain from throwing the nuclear bomb around carelessly. The charge is inactive. Combat mode will be enabled only upon confirmed delivery to <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color>.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.dlg.space_outro:
Shedu's Thousand has been eliminated. The attempt to turn Mars into a new staging ground for the quasimorph war has been thwarted.

RealWare has once again proven that it remains the only entity in the Solar System capable of resolving such crises at an acceptable cost. All others either create threats or become their fodder.

Now begins the truly important phase. Our next objective is to secure a foothold near Earth. Control over near-Earth space will allow RealWare to complete its force deployment in the theater where the fate of the entire Solar System will be decided.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.dlg.stage2_eipschwitz: We have a signal! Yes, yes, we are catching the clone's signature. He's alive! Listen carefully, I've opened a telephaturic passage for you to the <color=#FFFEC1>HIS Ares</color> of the <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> corporation. Don't just stand there. Jump. I have no idea how long I can hold this hole open.
story.rwa_4a_whirl.dlg.urparp_stage2_bom:
So this is how RealWare hoped to kill a god. With a spark drawn from the bones of the world.

Naive. The weapon in your hands is only a shadow of what was created in Ur. The fire with which you go to war is only a glimmer of the fires of Ur. Explosion, decay, tamed death—all of these are mere imitations of the powers that have long served my kingdom. And you think I will fall to the splitting of the atom? I am the one who commands the atom to split.

How naive your masters are. They thought they were striking at my heart, but they only opened my gates. Look. The stone is already trembling.

Now it is their turn. Let RealWare learn that fire does not belong to them. They merely reminded it of the road home.
